lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
He carved the grain of every oak,
Beneath a roof of shifting grey.
With steady hands and steady heart,
He shaped the wood to find the way.
[Pre-Chorus]
The hammer hums a steady beat,
Where heavy timber meets the floor.
[Chorus]
The valley holds the morning mist,
The mountains stand in silent pride.
Where ancient roots and river stones,
In patient cycles coil and bide.
[Verse]
A notch for every year he's known,
A grain for every dream he's spun.
He carves the spirit of the tree,
Until the work and man are one.
[Pre-Chorus]
The hammer hums a steady beat,
Where heavy timber meets the floor.
[Chorus]
The valley holds the morning mist,
The mountains stand in silent pride.
Where ancient roots and river stones,
In patient cycles coil and bide.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
The seasons turn like heavy wheels,
The seasons fade like falling snow.
[Chorus]
The valley holds the morning mist,
The mountains stand in silent pride.
Where ancient roots and river stones,
In patient cycles coil and bide.
[Outro]
